relevance_note: Case report of one man with a homozygous ABCA1 variant: "a pathological homozygous variant in ATP-binding cassette subfamily A member 1 (ABCA1) c.1510-1G > A, consistent with a diagnosis of TD".
method_note: Written by hand from a full reading of the paper; a short script only assembled the JSON. Three people in scope: the patient (single unnamed patient of a case report, label 'patient'), his sister and her son, who are described as 'reported to have splenomegaly of unknown cause' (included as affected relatives; not tested, no variant rows, no diagnosis given). His brother is only mentioned ('He has a brother and sister') with no fact about him, so he gets no row. Age '34-year-old' is the age at presentation with nephrotic syndrome in August 2017, not a stated age at Tangier symptom onset or at diagnosis, so onset, diagnosis and last-evaluation ages are left 'not reported'. Variant type not stated by the authors (not derived from the c. string). Creatinine was normal at presentation (61 µmol/L) and increased in 2021 (133 µmol/L); recorded as separate excluded and observed rows at different time points, not a contradiction. The negative lab panel sentence ('were normal or negative') was used under D-27 for each named test; 'Apart from ankle oedema, initial examination was unremarkable' excludes nothing specific and was not used. 'Hypoalphalipoproteinaemia' (Discussion) was not used for the low apolipoprotein A-I checklist item because apoA-I was not reported as measured. The Discussion's general statements about TD features (tonsils, reticulocytosis, atherosclerosis) are not about this patient and were not used. No contradictions found in the paper.
